items.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: one of your close associates is Bill Cosby. Yeah, old B.

ctx.x: I know one of the things that you – one of your close associates is Bill Cosby.

Every – the two years that I worked on the Monk – the t.v. show that the Monk people did with ABC t.v., each one of them opened up with a skit that you and Cosby concocted. Who was writing that material?
